scope: PackageManager tests with mocked storage plus static IndexedDB transaction contract checks; browser IndexedDB race/fault injection not run

results.name: Storage cleanup runs package and active-pointer reads in one write transaction
Cleanup retains the active package even when it is older than retention limit
Cleanup retains at least one verified package per package family
Cleanup does not use unverified records as retained versions
Package manager serializes cleanup after an in-flight operation
Rollback is queued through the package manager operation gate
Install and rollback share a serialized operation queue
Active package is re-read after cleanup and exposed in result
Current release and service worker cache align to Batch 49
Package pruning is constrained to verified records and keeps active id
Retention limit is normalized to a positive integer
